summary: Frontend-only validation completed for ecommerce routes and core interactions. Most flows work; found mobile header overflow and missing empty-state UX on Shop when filters return zero products.

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal overflow on 390px width (scrollWidth 396 > clientWidth 390). Header action group extends outside viewport.
No empty-state message when filters produce 0 products; product grid becomes blank area with only count text.

issues: Header content alignment causes slight horizontal clipping/overflow on small screens

action_items: Fix mobile header layout at <=390px (allow logo text truncation/shrink, reduce gap, or wrap actions)
Add explicit empty-state card/message and CTA when filteredProducts.length === 0 on Shop page
Re-run responsive regression for /checkout and /shop after header fix
critical_code_review_comments: SiteHeader uses fixed horizontal spacing with large logo text and right action group; on mobile this exceeds viewport width.
ShopPage lacks a conditional empty-result UI block; currently only count changes while core content area is blank.
seed_data_creation: None. Tested against static mock data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All primary routes and key interactions passed in browser automation: /, /shop, /product/:id, /cart, /checkout, /auth. Verify mobile fix specifically against [data-testid='header-action-group'] overflow and confirm a visible empty-state for 0-product filter cases.
rca of the issue:
RCA-1 Mobile overflow: SiteHeader has fixed layout density (logo text + action icons + gap) without small-screen shrink/truncation safeguards, causing right-edge overflow on 390px. Repro: open /checkout on mobile viewport 390x844 and compare documentElement.scrollWidth vs clientWidth. RCA-2 Empty-state gap: ShopPage renders paginatedProducts map directly with no fallback component when array is empty. Repro: /shop -> keep default Electronics category -> enable brand Zenith -> count becomes 0 and grid area is blank.

MOCKED: All ecommerce data is sourced from frontend static data (storeData.js), no live backend product/cart APIs exercised.
